messages:
Eli K: Quick sync thread — coordinating v2 rollout slots and SDK backports. Need owners and any blockers before we schedule canary next week. Main deps: node/python SDK backports, infra slot for canary, runbook updates, and a short fallback rule. @Priya_S can you confirm status on the backports?
Priya S: Working on node + python backports. Two flaky tests in python integration, isolating. goal: open PRs by EOD today, merge by Mon EOD if green. PR template ready.
Miguel R: Infra: we have free GPU pool windows Tue/Wed 07:00-10:00 PT. Can reserve Tue 07:00-08:30 for canary. Also need to update routing rules to keep v1 alias for unknown params — otherwise we risk 400s. I can do the routing change but need an owner to validate responses.
Sara L: Oncall note — if any header schema changes, quotas break. Are we changing headers?
Eli K: No header changes. We're removing query param `compat_mode` from v2, but aliasing it in routing for 30 days. So quotas unaffected.
Priya S: Backport command I'm using (pseudo):
```
git checkout -b backport/sdk-v2
git cherry-pick <commit>
./run_integration -t python
```
Linking draft PRs: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pulls?q=is%3Apr+backport
Miguel R: Reserving Tue 07:00 PT slot now. deploy-bot: please schedule maintenance window.
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window Tue 07:00-08:30 PT — tag `v2-canary-2026-03-24`.
devex-bot: added canary checklist to runbook: smoke tests, latency/error thresholds, rollback steps. Need canary owner for watch.
Sara L: I'll own canary watch. I'll create a Grafana panel to surface 95p latency and 5xx rate; will set alert thresholds and be on deck Tue.
Eli K: Great — owners: SDK backports (Priya S), infra slot (Miguel R), canary watch (Sara L), runbook + docs (devex-bot). Action items: 1) Priya open PRs by EOD and merge Mon EOD; 2) Miguel confirm infra reservation (done); 3) devex-bot publish runbook (done); 4) Sara prep dashboard and alerts (in progress). Any objections to Tue 07:00 PT canary?
Priya S: ack — will post PR links here once opened.
Miguel R: ack.
Sara L: ack — will post dashboard link.
Eli K: I'll follow up in the morning with PR links, canary tag, and a quick rollback play. :thumbsup:
